# 3.2. HDS Test 

## 3.2.1. Equipment description – T033 unit 

The HDS tests were performed on the T033 unit. The HDS test allows to evaluate the catalysts performance in a fixed bed reactor, under hydrogen pressure, close to the industrial HDS conditions. The T033 unit scheme is given on  Figure 24 . 

> Figure 24-Scheme of the unit T033

The T033 unit can be divided in three main sections: 

- Liquid and gas feed: 

The gas supply of nitrogen and hydrogen is provided by the local networks at high and low pressure values. Those lines are equipped with valves, particles filters, flow indicators (FI) and flow controllers (FC01, FC02, FC03, FC05). The gas supply of H 2S/H 2 is made by a pressurized bottle located in a ventilated cupboard (HEV12). 

The liquid feed is stored in a tank (T-04) and is continuously fed to the reactor by an HPLC pump of reciprocal type (P-04). The liquid flow is measured and regulated by the Quantim TM device (FC04) which requires a differential pressure about 2 bar (Coriolis effect). This differential pressure is imposed by a manual valve (coupled with a manometer) and at the same time allows pumping the liquid at high pressure. 

- Reactor and heating system: 

Prior to the reactor the arrivals of liquid and gas flow are mixed (T-03), whose mixture passes down-flow through the fixed bed reactor. 34 

The reactor is heated by an oven and the temperature is measured by a multipoint cane with three thermocouples (TI01, TI02, TI03). 

The pressure is measured by a Keller TM pressure indicator (PI13) and is regulated by a Kammer TM valve located at the reactor outlet line. 

The reactor outlet line is thermally insulated and heated at 280 ºC, keeping the reactor effluent in the gas phase and avoiding condensation of high boiling point compounds. This line is regulated by a thermocouple (TIC04) and has also a safety thermocouple. 

- Online analysis system: 

A nitrogen stream is injected in the reactor outlet line to dilute the reactor effluent which will be analysed online by gas chromatography, in split mode. The effluent samples are automatically injected by the VALCO valve into the capillary column. The compounds are identified by a flame ionization detector (FID). Finally, the export data is made by the Galaxie ® software. 

Before  being discharged from the unit,  the  effluent  passes through a tank c ontaining dodecane 

(T -06)  to ensure the dissolution of  condensing species and  prevent their crystallization  in the exhaust 

line .

## 3.2.2. Reactor Loading 

Before the catalytic test, the reactor must be loaded with the desired catalyst. The reactor (presented on  Figure 25 ) has as a diameter of 10 mm and a length of 18,2 cm, and allows to test 4 cm 3 of catalyst at each time. 

To have a good distribution of the catalyst in the reactor and a homogeneous temperature in the fixed bed, the following procedure was done: 

1. Load 4 cm 3 of silicon carbide (SiC), an inert solid material to ensure good thermal diffusion in the catalyst bed; 

2. Load a mixture of 4 cm 3 of SiC and 4 cm 3 of catalyst (previously mixed); 

3. Load again 4 cm 3 of SiC. 

At each loading step, the reactor must be "tapped" to optimize the bed stacking. After loading, a metallic filter is placed on the top of reactor and is screwed. Then the reactor is installed on the unit. 35

# 4.  Results and Discussion 

Three different generations of CoMo catalysts were tested to evaluate their performance towards HDS of 4,6-DMDBT in order to discriminate their catalytic properties on the DDS route. At the beginning the experimental error associated to the conversions and yields of 4,6-DMDBT transformation were determined (presented in Appendix 3). In a second part, a study of the H 2S influence was carried out for all catalysts, including the influence on the two pathways leading to 4,6-DMDBT conversion. Then it was defined the proper conditions to screen the different catalysts. Finally, a kinetic study on these results was conducted.

# 4.6. Conclusion 

The preliminary catalytic results obtained were in agreement with the former catalytic results related to the 4,6-DMDBT conversion and HYD pathway, whereas for the DDS pathway there was no discrimination with the initial chosen conditions. 

In order to obtain a discrimination between the catalysts on the DDS pathway, the operating conditions had to be modified. The parameter that seems to be the more pertinent was the H 2S partial pressure. 

The H 2S partial pressure was controlled by the quantity of DMDS introduced in the liquid feed. Therefore it was increased from 0.8 %wt of DMDS (initial conditions pH 2S = 0,22 bar) to 1,4 %wt of DMDS (pH 2S = 0,38 bar). At 1,2 %wt of DMDS (pH 2S = 0,32 bar) it was found a good discrimination between the catalysts and the results are very consistent with the HDS test on real feedstock. 

For these chosen conditions, the catalytic performances increased in the following sense: CoMo-1<CoMo-2<CoMo-3, whatever the temperature and the pathway considered. However the CoMo-1 catalyst was the less active but the more selective on DDS pathway. 

The increase on the overall HDS activity of 4,6-DMDBT through catalysts generation is actually achieved by an increasing of the HYD pathway. The results from toluene hydrogenation confirmed the higher hydrogenation capacity of the most recent generations, such as CoMo-3 catalyst. 

The apparent activation energy values are similar for the three solids, around 50 kcal/mol which seems to indicate that the 4,6-DMDBT conversion mechanism is the same for the three catalysts. 

Finally, the study of the influence of H 2S partial pressure showed that the three catalysts have very different behaviours. CoMo-1 and CoMo-2 were negative impacted on HYD and DDS pathways reflecting a decrease in the catalytic activity (more in the first case), whereas CoMo-3 was hardly affected by H 2S in the studied range. However, a slight promotion effect was observed at 290 ºC, but this should be confirmed by further experiments. 65 66 

# 5.  Conclusion and Perspectives 

The main objective of this work was to optimise the conditions of an existing HDS test in a fixed bed reactor, in the presence of 4,6-DMDBT for the future screening of CoMo sulfide catalysts used in diesel HDS. 

Three generations of commercial catalysts were evaluated by following the 4,6-DMDBT conversion, HYD and DDS pathways. The preliminary catalytic results obtained were in agreement with the former catalytic results related to the 4,6-DMDBT conversion and HYD pathway, whereas for the DDS pathway there was no discrimination with the initial chosen conditions. 

Therefore, the operating conditions were changed in order to have discrimination between the catalysts on the DDS pathway. The parameter that seems to be more appropriate was the H 2S partial pressure, controlled by the quantity of DMDS introduced in the liquid feed. Indeed, an increase in H 2Spartial pressure allowed to set up discriminatory conditions, since 1,2 %wt of DMDS added to the feed led to coherent results with those obtained on real feedstock. 

The catalytic performances increased in the order of: CoMo-1 < CoMo-2 < CoMo-3 and it was evidenced that the HDS activity of 4,6-DMDBT is enhanced from generation to generation by an increasing of the HYD pathway. 

Finally, the study of the influence of H 2S partial pressure showed that the three catalysts have very different behaviours. CoMo-1 and CoMo-2 were negative impacted on HYD and DDS pathways reflecting a decrease in the catalytic activity (more on the first case), whereas CoMo-3 was hardly affected by H 2S in the studied range. However, a slight promotion effect was observed, but this should be confirmed by further experiments. 

This could be done by decreasing the contact time (i.e. increasing LHSV) or increasing the H2S partial pressure. Moreover, the kinetic order with respect to 4,6-DMDBT could be determined by varying the LHSV for a given temperature, in order to confirm the hypothesis based on the literature of first-order reaction, particularly for new catalyst generation. 

The optimized HDS test is suitable to screen CoMo catalysts, with a high repeatability and allowing a rapid answer  on the transformation of refractory sulfide molecules (1 day test). Furthermore, 

this test also provides a better understanding on the catalytic performances of different catalysts 

generations and will be definite ly useful for the development of new highly active catalysts. 67 68

Your smile gives me strength! ” To my cousin Stella,  I want to thank all the 

supp ort that she gave me, since it  was crucial to help me arrive here. “You showed me the door for the 

beginning of my pathway and for that I am deeply thankful.” 2

Abstract 

In this work, the hydrodesulfurization (HDS) of 4,6-dimethyldibenzothiophene (4,6-DMDBT) was studied over three commercial generations of CoMoP/Al 2O3 catalysts in a fixed bed reactor under conditions close to those commonly used in diesel fuel hydrotreating (290 to 320 ºC and total pressure of 30 bar). 4,6-DMDBT is known to be transformed through two pathways: hydrogenation (HYD) and direct  desulfurization (DDS) .

Preliminary catalytic results obtained under typical operating conditions did not enable to discriminate the difference of reactivity of the three catalysts for DDS of 4,6-DMDBT. Therefore the operating conditions were changed in order to have discrimination on the DDS pathway. The parameter that seems to be more appropriate was the H 2S partial pressure, controlled by the quantity of dimethyldisulfide (DMDS) introduced in the liquid feed. Indeed an increase in H 2S partial pressure allowed to set up discriminatory conditions, since 1,2 %wt of DMDS led to coherent results with those obtained on real feedstock. 

The three generations of catalysts have different catalytic performances and the most recent generation of catalyst (CoMo-3) revealed to be the most active. It was observed that the HDS activity of 4,6-DMDBT is enhanced from generation to generation by an increasing of the HYD yield. 

Finally, the study of the influence of H 2S partial pressure showed very different behaviours between catalysts. CoMo-1 and CoMo-2 were negative impacted (more in the first case), whereas CoMo-3 was hardly affected by H 2S in the studied range. 

The optimized HDS test is now suitable to screen CoMo catalysts, with a high repeatability and allowing a rapid answer on the transformation of refractory sulfide molecules. 

Keywords: Diesel, deep hydrodesulfurization, 4,6-dimethyldibenzothiophene, CoMoP/Al 2O3,H2S partial pressure. 3

Resumo 

Neste trabalho, estudou-se a hidrodessulfurização (HDS) de 4,6-dimetildibenzotiofeno (4,6-DMDBT) em três gerações de catalisadores comerciais CoMoP/Al 2O3, num reactor de leito fixo em condições tipicamente utilizadas no hidrotratamento do gasóleo (290 a 320 ºC e uma pressão total de 30 bar). A transformação do 4,6-DMDBT ocorre através de duas vias reaccionais: a via de hidrogenação (HYD) e a via de dessulfurização directa (DSD). 

Os resultados dos testes catalíticos preliminares obtidos em condições típicas operacionais, não permitiram discriminar as diferentes reactividades dos três catalisadores pela via DSD da transformação do 4,6-DMDBT. Neste sentido, as condições operatórias foram modificadas para diferenciar a reactividade dos catalisadores dessa via. A pressão parcial de H 2S foi o parâmetro mais adequado a ser modificado, sendo controlada pela quantidade de dimetildissulfureto (DMDS) introduzida na alimentação líquida. De facto, um aumento da pressão parcial de H 2S permitiu definir as condições desejadas, uma vez que, os resultados obtidos a 1,2 %p/p (percentagem em peso) de DMDS foram coerentes com os resultados obtidos usando carga real (gasóleo industrial não tratado). 

As três gerações de catalisadores têm diferentes actividades catalíticas, sendo a geração mais recente (CoMo-3) aquela que apresenta a actividade catalítica mais elevada. De geração em geração, observou-se que a melhoria de HDS de 4,6-DMDBT é devida ao aumento do rendimento da via de hidrogenação. 

Finalmente, o estudo do impacto da pressão parcial de H 2S mostrou que os catalisadores têm comportamentos distintos. O catalisador CoMo-1 e CoMo-2 foram negativamente afectados (mais no primeiro caso), enquanto o CoMo-3 não foi praticamente afectado no intervalo de pressão parcial de H2S estudado. 

O teste de HDS optimizado é agora adequado para proceder à escolha de catalisadores CoMo, com uma elevada repetibilidade e com uma resposta rápida na reacção de transformação de moléculas de enxofre refractárias. 

Palavras-chave: Gasóleo, hidrodessulfurização profunda, 4,6-dimetildibenzotiofeno, CoMoP/Al 2O3, pressão parcial de H 2S. 4

(ii) to designate one arbitrator for each batch, provided that NAM may designate additional arbitrators for demands within a batch where it determines that doing so will provide for a more efficient resolution; (iii) to accept applicable fees, including any related fee reduction determined by NAM in its discretion; (iv) that no more than three batches of demands that are part of the Mass Filing may be filed, processed, or adjudicated at the same time, and that an additional batch shall be filed, processed, and adjudicated as each pending batch is adjudicated or otherwise resolved; (v) that fees associated with a demand for arbitration included in a Mass Filing, including fees owed by the Company and the claimants, shall only be due after Your demand for arbitration is included in a set of batch proceedings and that batch is properly designated for filing, processing, and adjudication; (vi) that the staged process of batched proceedings, with each set including 50 demands, shall continue until each demand (including Your demand) is adjudicated or otherwise resolved; and (vii) to make good faith efforts to resolve each batch of demands within 180-days to the extent possible, failing which any of the claimants or the Company may cease arbitration and file in a court of competent jurisdiction. Demands in a Mass Filing will be assigned sequential numbers in the order in which they are filed with NAM and will be assigned to batches, and the batches designated for filing, processing, and adjudication, in that order.

Arbitrator selection for the demands in each batch shall be conducted to the greatest extent possible in accordance with the applicable NAM rules and procedures for such selection, and the arbitrator will determine the location where the proceedings for each demand within a batch will be conducted.

For purposes of this subpart (15.7) and subpart (15.8), the “First Batch Resolution Date” means the earliest date on which all demands in any single batch have been adjudicated or otherwise resolved. ## About Social Science

From the first recorded use of tools to the invention of the smartphone, social science covers all of humanity’s most significant milestones. Explore overarching topics like anthropology, archaeology, gender studies, and ethnic studies. Understand the key issues of our time, like LGBTQ+ rights, the justice system, and discrimination and race relations. Or be transported back to where it all started with prehistoric rock art, human evolution, and early civilization. Scribd’s collection of social science PDFs spans thousands of years of history and offers a fascinating glimpse into the development of society and the ways in which humans, and human relationships, have changed over time. Whether you’re a sociology student or someone who wants to know more about themselves, their ancestors, and their community, you’re sure to find something of value. Scribd can be accessed using any web browser, Android, or iOS device, meaning you can learn about these topics and more from the comfort of your own home — or wherever life takes you. Sign up today to start your social science education.

## Frequently asked questions

What is Slideshare?

Slideshare is the presentation-sharing platform for anyone looking for slide inspiration, to showcase their knowledge, or to build on their own ideas. With over 25M+ presentations and 70M+ active users, Slideshare is the place where big ideas live.

Why does Slideshare look different?

Slideshare is stepping into a bold new chapter with a refreshed identity. While the core of what you love remains the same — access to over 25 million decks, powerful AI tools, and a global network of 70+ million curious minds — Slideshare now carries a cleaner, sharper look. This rebrand emphasizes our renewed mission: helping people transform their ideas into opportunities. With this fresh energy, Slideshare continues to be the trusted home for expert insights and standout presentations. This update is just the beginning, designed to better serve creators and thinkers like you.

Do I need a subscription to access Slideshare?

No subscription is required to access Slideshare — you can still browse, read, and upload content. However, a subscription gives you additional benefits such as the ability to download presentations and enjoy an ad-free browsing experience.

What is included in a Slideshare subscription?

A paid subscription includes the following exclusive benefits:

*   Download presentations
*   Copy and paste text directly from presentations
*   Enjoy an ad-free experience
*   Complimentary access to millions of documents on Scribd

How do I cancel my subscription?

You can cancel your subscription anytime by visiting your account settings. If you cancel, you'll continue to have access to your subscription benefits until the remaining time expires.

## **1.0 About this Privacy Policy; Other Terms**[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9J8QG82W74WB7BP4WYA)

Everand™, Scribd®, and Slideshare® are brands or products of Scribd, Inc. (“the Company”, “we,” “our,” or “us”). The following additional terms, policies, and rules are expressly incorporated herein and form a binding part of this Agreement as if reproduced fully herein:

1.   Scribd, Inc. Global Terms of Use ([https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129326](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129326))
2.   Everand Subscriber Agreement ([https://support.scribd.com/hc/en-us/articles/210129486-Subscriber-Agreement](https://support.scribd.com/hc/en-us/articles/210129486-Subscriber-Agreement))
3.   Privacy Notice for **California Residents** ([https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/360038024311-California-Privacy-Notice](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/360038024311-California-Privacy-Notice))

This Global Privacy Policy (“Privacy Policy,” or “Policy”), and its associated notices and disclosures, are incorporated into, and are subject to, our Global Terms of Use. Unless otherwise defined in this Policy, all capitalized terms have the meaning given in the Global Terms of Use.

We provide this Policy to inform our visitors, users, and subscribers (“you,” or “your”) about our data practices, the kinds of information that we collect, and how we intend to use and disclose (collectively, “Process”) that information.

Your use of our sites, apps, and other online products and services that link to this Privacy Policy (collectively, the “Services”) and any information that you provide through the Services or through your interactions with us are subject at all times to this Privacy Policy and any regional disclosures relevant to the place where you access the Services.

BY ACCESSING, BROWSING, OR USING ANY OF THE SERVICES THAT WE PROVIDE, YOU ACKNOWLEDGE THAT YOU HAVE READ AND UNDERSTOOD THIS POLICY, AND AGREE TO THE PROCESSING DESCRIBED IN THIS POLICY. IF YOU CHOOSE TO MAKE ANY OF YOUR INFORMATION PUBLICLY AVAILABLE VIA THE SERVICES, YOU ACKNOWLEDGE THAT YOU DO SO AT YOUR OWN RISK.

## **2.0 Information We Collect and How We Use It**[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9JBTRD7ZP3WYGCWWXY3)

The information that we collect and how we use or disclose it depends on your relationship with us and any applicable laws and regulations. In this section, we describe some of the ways that we collect and use information and the legal bases for doing so. We endeavor to collect only the limited amount of information that is relevant for the purposes of Processing as described in this Policy and its related policies as noted in Section 1.0.

If you apply for a job with Scribd or otherwise engage with us in connection with employment (including as an employee, contractor, or other personnel), the personal information we process in that context is subject to our Employee and Applicant Privacy Policy, which is available [here](https://support.scribd.com/hc/en-us/articles/49754646187284-Employee-and-Applicant-Privacy-Policy-and-Notice-at-Collection).

### **2.1 How We Collect Information**[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9JC66RCD2P270VWE3W6)

The data that we collect from or about you depends on how you use the Services or interact with us. Some of the ways that we Process your personal information (“Personal Information”) may include when you:

*   Register for an account; register for or attend an event;
*   Subscribe to or purchase a product;
*   Participate in a contest, promotion, or survey;
*   Sign up to receive information, including marketing, from us;
*   Use our Services, including submitting content or feedback to us or otherwise contact Us; or
*   Visit or engage with our Sites, Apps, Services.

### **2.2 Information You Provide to Us**[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9JEXSVNMW7D6P7MMNEH)

We collect the following information that you provide to us directly:

*   Contact information such as your name, e-mail address, street address, and phone number;
*   Payment information such as your credit card number (processed by our third-party payment processor) and expiration date, where appropriate to process a financial transaction that you have requested;
*   Transaction information such as your order (e.g., subscription) information;
*   User-Generated Content such as documents, comments, images, photos, videos, or other content you provide to the Services;
*   Profile Information if you choose to provide it, such as a profile picture, professional information (like job title and company), general location (like city and state);
*   Engagement with Interactive Content on the Service such as responses to questions, surveys; searches for recommendations; and clicks on such interactive content; and
*   Contents of communications with us,such as comments, requests, feedback and questions you submit through customer service interactions with us and recordings of calls when you call customer service.

We may use the information you provide, along with the information we collect automatically and from third parties, to make inferences about you, including your preferences and interests.

### **2.3 Information We Collect Automatically**[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9JGTW1YMNNMQ6694K2C)

We and service providers on our behalf automatically collect certain information about your use of the Services or your device. For example, we collect:

*   Device information such as hardware model, IP address, device identifiers, operating system, browser type and settings (like language and available font settings) and settings of the device you use to access the Services.
*   Usage information, including, but not limited to, your use of the Services, navigational data, the name of the domain and host from which you access the Internet, the date and time you access the Services, customer service interactions, and how you interact with our emails.
*   Location information such as general location derived from your computer’s IP address.

We and our service providers use cookies, web beacons, and other tracking technologies to collect such information.

### **2.4 Information from Third Party Sources**[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9JHHJG1SPE5W6DCAFDR)

[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy)We may process supplemental information about you from third parties in order to verify the information that you have provided to us and to enhance our ability to provide you with customer support and information about our businesses, products and Services. We may also occasionally offer optional service features by means of a third party application or service. We may receive information about you from these third parties if you choose to accept such offers. We may receive information about you from:

*   Publicly and commercially available data sources, as permitted by law, including contact information, demographic data, and interests.
*   Social media services,if you interact with us through a social media service or log in using social media credentials. Depending on your social media settings, we may have access to your information from that service, such as your name, email address, friend or followers/following list, profile and demographic information, current city, comments about or reactions to our Services, and the people/sites you follow.
*   Data analytics providers and advertising partners,including usage information, demographic information, information about your activity and transactions on other websites or platforms or with other companies, and inferred interests about You.

### **2.5 How We Use Your Information**[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9JJ7TM4FGWPCMMSGCEZ)

Depending on how you use the Services, we and our service providers may use your information as follows:

*   Provide Information and Services that You Request. We may use the information about you to provide you with Services or information that you request (such as information about a product or service) including to: (a) manage your account information and settings; (b) process payments; (c) ; (c) verify your identity (d) provide access to certain areas and features; and (e) permit you to register for, and participate in, online and in-person events.
*   Improve and Personalize the Services.We may use the information about you to improve and personalize the Services, including, without limitation, to: (a) measure and analyze your interest in our Sites, Apps, programs or Services; (b) perform internal quality control; and (c) personalize the Services for you.
*   Communicate with you.We may use the information about you to communicate with you, including to (a) respond to your questions, comments and requests (e.g. customer support requests and legal requests) and (b) send you communications regarding the Sites, Apps, programs, Services, your Account(s) and/or Subscription, or any changes to any company policy, terms, or agreement.
*   Market and Advertise Products and Services. We may use the information about you to provide you with materials about offers, products, and our Services. We may provide you with these materials by notification via the Services, postal mail, email, or other electronic notification as permitted by applicable laws. We may work with third parties to provide you with personalized ads on the Services through the automatic collection of information (e.g. cookies) or to advertise the Services on other sites and services. You can opt out of marketing communications at any time by clicking the unsubscribe link in any commercial communication from us. Please note that, even if you opt out of marketing communications, we may continue to send you transactional communications related to your account or use of the Services.
*   Research and Development. We may use your information to create de-identified, anonymous, or pseudonymous information that we may use, alone or in the aggregate, along with information obtained from other sources, for any purpose, including to help us to optimally deliver our existing products and services or develop new products, processes and services.
*   Surveys. We may occasionally engage third parties to conduct voluntary surveys on our behalf. Responses may be utilized to determine the effectiveness of the Services, the Company's communications, advertising campaigns, and/or promotional activities. If you participate in a survey, the information given will be used along with that of other study participants. The information collected will be used to help us to learn more about your needs and the quality of the products and services that we provide to you. We may occasionally disclose de-identified and aggregated data to third parties for research and analysis purposes.
*   Sharing Content with Friends or Colleagues. We may offer various tools and functionality that will allow you to forward or share certain content.
*   To Protect the Rights of the Services and Others and Comply with Law.We use your information if we, in good faith, believe it is necessary or appropriate to secure, protect, enforce, or defend the legal rights, privacy, safety, or property of the Services, its employees or agents, or other users, and to comply with applicable law and legal process. This includes using your information in order to prevent fraud and to protect the accuracy and integrity of financial transactions made throughout the Services and enforcing our Global Terms of Use, this Policy, and other related policies.
*   With Consent. We use your information with your consent or at your direction.
*   Deidentified and Aggregated Data. We may use your information and other information about you to create de-identified and aggregated data. Our use and disclosure of de-identified information is not subject to any restrictions under this Privacy Policy, and we may use de-identified data for research, analysis, analytics, and any other legally permissible purposes.

## **3.0 How We Disclose Your Information**[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9JPPZZDYV1PQFG5Z3XM)

We do not sell, share, or otherwise disclose Personal Information about you, except when you allow us to do so, or as otherwise described in this Privacy Policy. We endeavor to require third parties to which we disclose Personal Information to protect it using substantially similar standards to those required by us (and at least the same level of privacy protection as is required by applicable laws), and to notify us if they make a determination they can no longer meet this obligation.

We may disclose your information in the following ways:

### 3.1 Service Providers[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9JQGR9Y24GV115VT6Y8)

We may disclose Information to vendors that perform certain services on our behalf including (i) provision of information technology (IT) and related services; (ii) provision of information and services you have requested; (iii) payment processing; (iv) fraud prevention; and (v) customer service activities. Payment information will be used and shared only to process your order and may be stored by a third party payment processor for purposes of fraud prevention and future orders.

### 3.2 Third Party Features[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9JQHKJ7Q88FPFMM1EPQ)

We may offer features that allow you to access or disclose content with third party social media websites and apps, discussion boards, blogs, wikis, and other third party services. Please be aware that any information you provide to a third party will be subject to that third party’s privacy policy.

If you use a third party resource through one of our Services, we may collect Personal Information so that we can provide you with access to Services offered either by us or a third party; and we may be able to access any information that you make public through the Third Party resource (such as your username, comments, posts and contacts) and any other information that you permit us to access. Please carefully consider what Personal Information you share with others when using third party resources.

### 3.3 Affiliates.[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9JREN1W5VXY1G14ADMW)

We may disclose information to o ur affiliates for o ur and o ur affiliates’ internal business purposes, or to provide y ou with a product or service that y ou have requested.

### 3.4 Business Partners[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9JS0RE2YPRNDDSQ670B)

We may disclose information with our business partners to provide you with a product or service that you have requested. We may also provide Personal Information to business partners with whom we may jointly offer products or services, or whose products or services we believe may be of interest to You.

### 3.5 Advertising Partners[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9JTQTHCHS4VN2T3Q82F)

We may disclose or make available information to third parties to provide ads (including targeted ads) and personalized content, or to measure and analyze ad performance, on our Services or other websites or platforms.

### 3.6 For Our Protection and the Protection of Others[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCT4TWK00GP4BW7NXBW5TQW9)

We may disclose information about you: (i) if we are required to do so by law, court order, or another sufficient legal process; (ii) in response to lawful requests by public authorities, including to meet national security or law enforcement requirements; (iii) under the discovery process in litigation; (iv) to enforce our policies or contracts or to protect our Services, us, our users, or others; (v) to collect amounts owed to us; (vi) when we believe disclosure is necessary or appropriate to prevent physical harm or financial loss or in connection with an investigation or prosecution of suspected or actual illegal activity; or (vii) if we, in good faith, believe that disclosure is otherwise necessary or advisable.

### 3.7 In Connection with Business Transactions[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9JT0H485RE6QGB3X8EG)

We reserve the right to disclose or transfer your information in the event of a proposed or actual purchase, any reorganization, sale, lease, merger, joint venture, assignment, amalgamation or any other type of acquisition, disposal or financing of all or any portion of our business or of any of the business assets or shares (including in connection with any bankruptcy or similar proceeding).

### 3.8 With Your Consent or At Your Direction[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9JVCG6F5DVZXK9JKEMZ)

We also disclose information about you to third parties whenever you consent to or direct such sharing.

### 3.9 Cross-border Data Transfers[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9JWAV6FSJMA9NHP65MX)

Personal Information that we send or collect may be stored anywhere in the world in compliance with applicable law, including but not limited to our servers, the servers of our affiliates, and the servers of our service providers in the United States and European Union. By providing information to us, you consent to the storage of your Personal Information in these locations.

## **4.0 Online Analytics Information and Advertising**[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9JWF7ABZ4VNHXD9WHGW)

We, as well as service providers and third parties that provide content, advertising, or other functionality on our Sites, Apps, and Services, may use cookies, pixel tags, local storage, and other technologies (“Technologies”) to automatically collect information about you when you access the Services by means of a computer, tablet, mobile phone, or other device (“Device”).

*   Cookies are small text files placed in your Device’s browser to store your preferences. For information on how to accept or reject cookies (including third-party cookies), please click the ‘**Your Privacy Choices**’ link (or ‘**Cookie Preferences**’ in the EU) in the footer of the Sites. If you do not allow our Service’s cookies, then the Sites may not work properly.
*   A pixel tag (or web beacon) is a piece of code embedded on a Site page that collects information about your engagement on that page.
*   We use Google Analytics to collect information regarding visitor behavior and visitor demographics on some of our Services. These data are not tied to any information. For more information about Google Analytics, please visit: https://www.google.com/policies/privacy/partners/. You can opt out of Google’s collection and Processing of data generated by your use of the Services at: http://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout.

Our uses of such Technologies fall into the following general categories:

*   Operationally Necessary. We may use certain Technologies that are necessary to operate our Services; that are required to identify irregular Service behavior, prevent fraudulent activity and improve security; or that allow you to access and make use of our Services.
*   Performance Related. We may use certain Technologies to assess the performance of our Services, including as part of our analysis of the way you use the Sites and Apps, to determine if you have interacted with our messaging, to determine whether you have viewed an item or link, or to improve our Services.
*   Functionality Related. We may use certain Technologies to offer you enhanced functionality when accessing or using our Services. This may include identifying you when you sign into our sites or keeping track of your specific preferences, interests, or past items viewed so that we may enhance the presentation of content to you on our sites.
*   Advertising or Targeting Related. We may use first-party or third-party cookies and web beacons to deliver content, including ads relevant to your interests, on our Services or on third party sites. This includes using Technologies to understand the usefulness to you of the advertisements and content that has been delivered to you, such as whether you have clicked on an advertisement.

If you would like to opt-out of certain of these Technologies, you may do so by blocking, deleting, or disabling them as your browser or device permits, though this may impact the Services. Visit[https://optout.networkadvertising.org/](https://optout.networkadvertising.org/) to learn more about opting out of interest-based advertising. For additional ways to opt-out of targeted advertising activities under applicable law, see the “Your Rights and Choices” section below.

## **5.0 Your Rights & Choices**[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9JZCT6GGRFGW7YBFZ90)

### **5.1 Information Rights and Choices**[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9JZVV88DEZTX0HG2QWM)

We provide you with the ability to exercise certain controls and choices regarding our collection, use, and disclosure of your information. Depending on the laws in your jurisdiction of residence (i.e., California, Colorado, Connecticut, Indiana, Iowa, Kentucky, Maryland, Minnesota, Montana, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Jersey, Oregon, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, other US states with applicable privacy laws, and the EEA, UK and Switzerland), you may:

*   ask that we correct, amend, or delete your information
*   restrict or object to the processing of certain of your information

California, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Indiana, Iowa, Kentucky, Maryland, Minnesota, Montana, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Jersey, Oregon, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, Utah and Virginia residents also have opt out rights described below in Section 5.2.

California and Oregon residents can also request information about the categories of personal information we collect, disclose or sell or share about You. California residents can request the categories of sources of such information; the business or commercial purpose for collecting or selling or sharing your personal information; and the categories of third parties to whom we disclose personal information. Such information is also set forth in this Privacy Policy. Residents of certain other countries may be able request one or more of the above under applicable law.

Such requests will be processed in line with your local laws to the extent possible by this Privacy Policy.

If you would like information regarding your rights or would like to make a request (or if you are an authorized agent acting in accordance with applicable law), use [this](https://support.scribd.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038016931-Privacy-Rights-Request-Form) form.

Your rights and our responses will vary based on your state or country of residency. You may be located in a jurisdiction where we are not obligated, or are unable, to fulfill a request. In such a case, your request may not be fulfilled. Certain information may be exempt from such requests under applicable law such as information we retain for legal compliance and to secure our Services. We may need certain information in order to provide the Services to you; if you ask us to delete it, you may no longer be able to use the Services. To protect your privacy, we will take commercially reasonable steps to verify your identity before granting access to or making any changes to your information. If you are an authorized agent submitting a request on behalf of another individual, we may require proof of your written authorization before processing the request.

Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Indiana, Iowa, Kentucky, Maryland, Minnesota, Montana, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Jersey, Oregon, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, and Virginia residents may appeal the denial of a request by emailing us at privacy@scribd.com and including “Rights Appeal” in the subject line.

### **5.2 Sale/Targeted Advertising Opt Out Rights**[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9K2XAGXY03CVKBPDBNS)

If you are a California, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Indiana, Iowa, Kentucky, Maryland, Minnesota, Montana, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Jersey, Oregon, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, Utah or Virginia resident, you may opt out of the sale of your information or processing of your information for targeted advertising, under applicable law.

We may use internally-generated and third-party analytics and advertising tools that result in the disclosure of your information, including device information and identifiers, such as IP address, and unique advertising identifiers and cookies; browsing history or app usage; identifiers (which may be hashed) such as contact information, and general location information, such as city, to our third-party partners and that are subject to this opt out right. You can opt out of both activities by clicking “Your Privacy Choices” (or “Cookie Preferences” in the EU) on our website.

Note, if you use a cookie blocker such as Ghostery, it may block visibility of this tool or link, including in your web footer. Even if you opt out, you will still see advertising, it just may be less relevant to you.If you have enabled a legally recognized browser-based opt out preference signal (such as Global Privacy Control) on your browser, we recognize such preference in accordance and to the extent required by applicable law.

### **5.3 Marketing Choices**[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9K3WPJP6WA33PMNE59S)

You can opt out of receiving marketing emails from us through the “Unsubscribe” link in marketing emails. Please note that your request will take some time to process, in accordance with applicable law. We may continue to send you transaction emails, including about your purchases and transactions, or support-related emails related to pending or previous support tickets that you have filed with us. You will not be able to opt-out of emails that we are legally required to send you.

### **5.4 Account and Subscription Management**[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KVXTT5E5TBZ160MRJD3DFTMT)

You can access or modify your account and manage your subscriptions [here](https://www.scribd.com/account-settings). In addition, you can submit requests regarding the personal information associated with your account (including requests to delete your personal information that we process) using [this](https://support.scribd.com/hc/en-us/articles/360038016931-Privacy-Rights-Request-Form) form.  
  
If you use Facebook to log in to our services and want to delete personal data associated with that login, submit that request by email at [privacy@scribd.com](mailto:privacy@scribd.com). We will delete the previously collected personal data that we associated with your Facebook login, except as set forth in applicable law. This will terminate the Facebook login for your Scribd account and stop personal data collection via your Facebook login unless you reuse the Facebook login to access Scribd's products.

## **6.0 Information Regarding Certain Users**[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9K3PQX9MBY4075ZC8HX)

### **6.2 EEA, UK and****Switzerland****Residents**[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9K4AZBESMWSFBTMR8BQ)

[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy)**Legal Bases for Processing**

[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy)**Data Subject Rights**

## **7.0 Data Retention and Security**[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9K9NDNAHZS0GB2HWCPF)

### **2.1 How We Collect Information**[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9JC66RCD2P270VWE3W6)

### **2.2 Information You Provide to Us**[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9JEXSVNMW7D6P7MMNEH)

We collect the following information that you provide to us directly:

*   Contact information such as your name, e-mail address, street address, and phone number;
*   Payment information such as your credit card number (processed by our third-party payment processor) and expiration date, where appropriate to process a financial transaction that you have requested;
*   Transaction information such as your order (e.g., subscription) information;
*   User-Generated Content such as documents, comments, images, photos, videos, or other content you provide to the Services;
*   Profile Information if you choose to provide it, such as a profile picture, professional information (like job title and company), general location (like city and state);
*   Engagement with Interactive Content on the Service such as responses to questions, surveys; searches for recommendations; and clicks on such interactive content; and
*   Contents of communications with us,such as comments, requests, feedback and questions you submit through customer service interactions with us and recordings of calls when you call customer service.

We may use the information you provide, along with the information we collect automatically and from third parties, to make inferences about you, including your preferences and interests.

### **2.3 Information We Collect Automatically**[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9JGTW1YMNNMQ6694K2C)

We and service providers on our behalf automatically collect certain information about your use of the Services or your device. For example, we collect:

*   Device information such as hardware model, IP address, device identifiers, operating system, browser type and settings (like language and available font settings) and settings of the device you use to access the Services.
*   Usage information, including, but not limited to, your use of the Services, navigational data, the name of the domain and host from which you access the Internet, the date and time you access the Services, customer service interactions, and how you interact with our emails.
*   Location information such as general location derived from your computer’s IP address.

We and our service providers use cookies, web beacons, and other tracking technologies to collect such information.

### **2.4 Information from Third Party Sources**[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9JHHJG1SPE5W6DCAFDR)

[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy)We may process supplemental information about you from third parties in order to verify the information that you have provided to us and to enhance our ability to provide you with customer support and information about our businesses, products and Services. We may also occasionally offer optional service features by means of a third party application or service. We may receive information about you from these third parties if you choose to accept such offers. We may receive information about you from:

*   Publicly and commercially available data sources, as permitted by law, including contact information, demographic data, and interests.
*   Social media services,if you interact with us through a social media service or log in using social media credentials. Depending on your social media settings, we may have access to your information from that service, such as your name, email address, friend or followers/following list, profile and demographic information, current city, comments about or reactions to our Services, and the people/sites you follow.
*   Data analytics providers and advertising partners,including usage information, demographic information, information about your activity and transactions on other websites or platforms or with other companies, and inferred interests about You.

### **2.5 How We Use Your Information**[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9JJ7TM4FGWPCMMSGCEZ)

Depending on how you use the Services, we and our service providers may use your information as follows:

*   Provide Information and Services that You Request. We may use the information about you to provide you with Services or information that you request (such as information about a product or service) including to: (a) manage your account information and settings; (b) process payments; (c) ; (c) verify your identity (d) provide access to certain areas and features; and (e) permit you to register for, and participate in, online and in-person events.
*   Improve and Personalize the Services.We may use the information about you to improve and personalize the Services, including, without limitation, to: (a) measure and analyze your interest in our Sites, Apps, programs or Services; (b) perform internal quality control; and (c) personalize the Services for you.
*   Communicate with you.We may use the information about you to communicate with you, including to (a) respond to your questions, comments and requests (e.g. customer support requests and legal requests) and (b) send you communications regarding the Sites, Apps, programs, Services, your Account(s) and/or Subscription, or any changes to any company policy, terms, or agreement.
*   Market and Advertise Products and Services. We may use the information about you to provide you with materials about offers, products, and our Services. We may provide you with these materials by notification via the Services, postal mail, email, or other electronic notification as permitted by applicable laws. We may work with third parties to provide you with personalized ads on the Services through the automatic collection of information (e.g. cookies) or to advertise the Services on other sites and services. You can opt out of marketing communications at any time by clicking the unsubscribe link in any commercial communication from us. Please note that, even if you opt out of marketing communications, we may continue to send you transactional communications related to your account or use of the Services.
*   Research and Development. We may use your information to create de-identified, anonymous, or pseudonymous information that we may use, alone or in the aggregate, along with information obtained from other sources, for any purpose, including to help us to optimally deliver our existing products and services or develop new products, processes and services.
*   Surveys. We may occasionally engage third parties to conduct voluntary surveys on our behalf. Responses may be utilized to determine the effectiveness of the Services, the Company's communications, advertising campaigns, and/or promotional activities. If you participate in a survey, the information given will be used along with that of other study participants. The information collected will be used to help us to learn more about your needs and the quality of the products and services that we provide to you. We may occasionally disclose de-identified and aggregated data to third parties for research and analysis purposes.
*   Sharing Content with Friends or Colleagues. We may offer various tools and functionality that will allow you to forward or share certain content.
*   To Protect the Rights of the Services and Others and Comply with Law.We use your information if we, in good faith, believe it is necessary or appropriate to secure, protect, enforce, or defend the legal rights, privacy, safety, or property of the Services, its employees or agents, or other users, and to comply with applicable law and legal process. This includes using your information in order to prevent fraud and to protect the accuracy and integrity of financial transactions made throughout the Services and enforcing our Global Terms of Use, this Policy, and other related policies.
*   With Consent. We use your information with your consent or at your direction.
*   Deidentified and Aggregated Data. We may use your information and other information about you to create de-identified and aggregated data. Our use and disclosure of de-identified information is not subject to any restrictions under this Privacy Policy, and we may use de-identified data for research, analysis, analytics, and any other legally permissible purposes.

## **3.0 How We Disclose Your Information**[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9JPPZZDYV1PQFG5Z3XM)

We do not sell, share, or otherwise disclose Personal Information about you, except when you allow us to do so, or as otherwise described in this Privacy Policy. We endeavor to require third parties to which we disclose Personal Information to protect it using substantially similar standards to those required by us (and at least the same level of privacy protection as is required by applicable laws), and to notify us if they make a determination they can no longer meet this obligation.

We may disclose your information in the following ways:

### 3.1 Service Providers[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9JQGR9Y24GV115VT6Y8)

We may disclose Information to vendors that perform certain services on our behalf including (i) provision of information technology (IT) and related services; (ii) provision of information and services you have requested; (iii) payment processing; (iv) fraud prevention; and (v) customer service activities. Payment information will be used and shared only to process your order and may be stored by a third party payment processor for purposes of fraud prevention and future orders.

The information that we collect or receive about you may be transferred to, and processed by, recipients that are located inside or outside the EEA+ and which are not recognized from an EEA+ law perspective as providing for an adequate level of data protection. When interacting with our site or contacting us, you transfer information to the United States, and Scribd may then transfer your information back to the originating country. To the extent your information is transferred to countries that do not provide for an adequate level of data protection from an EU, Swiss or UK law perspective, we will base the respective transfer on appropriate safeguards, such as standard data protection contractual clauses adopted by the European Commission. You can ask for a copy of such appropriate safeguards by contacting us as set out in the contact section.

[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/en-us/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy)**Data Subject Rights**

Please see the “Your Rights & Choices” section for information about the rights you have with respect to your information under applicable law and how to exercise them.

In addition to those rights, you also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority in your country.

If you have declared your consent for any information processing activities, you can withdraw this consent at any time with future effect. Such a withdrawal will not affect the lawfulness of the processing prior to the consent withdrawal. You can exercise your rights by contacting us as described in Section 1.0.

## **7.0 Data Retention and Security**[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/en-us/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9K9NDNAHZS0GB2HWCPF)

We retain the information that we receive as described in this Privacy Policy for as long as we determine is necessary to fulfill the purpose(s) for which it was collected, provide our products and services, resolve disputes, establish legal defenses, conduct audits, pursue legitimate business purposes, enforce our agreements, and comply with applicable laws. Our retention is based upon the amount, nature and sensitivity of the information, the potential risk of harm from unauthorized use or disclosure of the information, the purposes for which we process the information, applicable legal requirements, and our legitimate interests. The purposes for which we process information may dictate different retention periods for the same types of information.

While we employ various technical and organizational measures to protect your information, we cannot ensure or warrant the security of any information you transmit to Us, and you do so at your own risk. You are responsible for maintaining the secrecy of your own passwords. If you have reason to believe that your passwords and/or information are no longer secure, please promptly notify us at privacy@scribd.com.

## **8.0 Links to Third-Party Websites**[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/en-us/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9K9ZA8B5WABTY4YMM60)

Our Services may contain links to third party websites that are not owned or operated by us. Third party websites and privacy practices may differ from ours, and we do not endorse or make any representations about third party websites. Any information you choose to give to unrelated third parties is not covered by this Privacy Policy. We encourage you to review all relevant privacy policies before providing your information to anyone. Some third parties may choose to disclose their users’ information with us; that sharing is governed by that company’s privacy policy, not this Privacy Policy.

## **9.0 Changes to the Privacy Policy**[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/en-us/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9K937RGC2D5FT2585M6)

We may occasionally update this Privacy Policy. If we make material changes to this Privacy Policy, we will notify as otherwise required by applicable laws. We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically to remain informed as to how we are using and protecting your information and to keep yourself aware of any changes to the Policy. Changes to this Privacy Policy will take effect immediately after we post it to[https://scribd.com/privacy](https://scribd.com/privacy). You can determine when we last changed this Policy by referring to the “Updated” legend above.

## **10.0 How to Contact Us**[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/en-us/articles/210129366-Privacy-policy#h_01KCM3H9KARZ8JNJWPTDHT1111)

We welcome your questions about our Privacy Policy and practices by email at [privacy@scribd.com](mailto:privacy@scribd.com). If you are a citizen of the EU, UK, or Switzerland, please contact us at the contact information provided above. If any request remains unresolved, you may contact the national data protection authority for your EU Member State.

### 15.2 Informelles Streitbeilegungsverfahren[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/change_language/de?return_to=/hc/de/articles/210129326-Globale-Nutzungsbedingungen#h_01HRD8X55RBCRH9ZGMEFFNHSQT)

Entsteht zwischen Uns eine Streitigkeit ("Dispute") (wie nachstehend definiert), sind Wir bereit, mit Ihnen zusammenzuarbeiten, um eine angemessene Lösung zu erreichen. Hinsichtlich einer solchen Streitigkeit erkennen beide Parteien an und vereinbaren, dass sie sich zunächst nach Kräften und in gutem Glauben bemühen werden, die Streitigkeit informell und unmittelbar durch Beratungen und Verhandlungen beizulegen, bevor sie ein formelles Streitbeilegungsverfahren, sei es im Schiedsverfahren oder auf andere Weise, einleiten. Eine solche informelle Beilegung setzt voraus, dass der anderen Partei zunächst eine schriftliche Beschreibung der Streitigkeit übersandt wird. Hinsichtlich jeder von Ihnen eingeleiteten Streitigkeit vereinbaren Sie, die schriftliche Beschreibung der Streitigkeit zusammen mit der Ihrem Konto ("Account") oder Abonnement ("Subscription") zugeordneten E-Mail-Adresse, sofern zutreffend, an Scribd, Inc., 460 Bryant Street, Ste. 300, San Francisco, CA 94107, sowie an legal@scribd.com zu senden. Die schriftliche Beschreibung ist auf individueller Grundlage zu erstellen und muss mindestens die folgenden Angaben enthalten: Ihren Namen und Ihre Kontaktdaten; eine Beschreibung der Art oder Grundlage des Anspruchs oder der Streitigkeit; die konkret begehrte Rechtsfolge; sowie Angaben, die zur Identifizierung Ihres Kontos, Ihres Abonnements oder der sonstigen betroffenen Beziehung zu Uns ausreichen. Hinsichtlich jeder von Uns eingeleiteten Streitigkeit vereinbaren Wir, Ihnen die schriftliche Beschreibung der Streitigkeit an die Ihrem Konto oder Abonnement zugeordnete E-Mail-Adresse zu senden oder, sofern solche Angaben nicht verfügbar sind, auf andere Weise, die nach billigem Ermessen geeignet ist, Ihnen tatsächliche Kenntnis zu verschaffen. Die schriftliche Beschreibung ist auf individueller Grundlage zu erstellen und muss mindestens die folgenden Angaben enthalten: Unsere Kontaktdaten für die Zwecke dieses informellen Beilegungsverfahrens; eine Beschreibung der Art oder Grundlage des Anspruchs oder der Streitigkeit; die konkret begehrte Rechtsfolge; sowie Angaben, die zur Identifizierung des Kontos, des Abonnements oder der sonstigen betroffenen Beziehung zu Uns ausreichen. Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, Ihre Kontaktdaten aktuell zu halten, im Einklang mit Abschnitt 5.0. Jede nach diesem Abschnitt 15.2 übersandte schriftliche Beschreibung gilt am Tag ihrer Absendung als zugegangen. Sofern die Parteien keine Verlängerung der Frist für die informelle Beilegung vereinbaren, vereinbaren Sie und die Gesellschaft ("the Company"), dass, wenn die Streitigkeit nicht innerhalb von sechzig (60) Tagen nach Zugang der schriftlichen Beschreibung der Streitigkeit beigelegt ist, die nachstehenden weiteren Bestimmungen zur Beilegung von Streitigkeiten gelten.

Das informelle Streitbeilegungsverfahren nach diesem Abschnitt 15.2 ist eine Vorbedingung und aufschiebende Bedingung für die Einleitung eines formellen Streitbeilegungsverfahrens. Vorbehaltlich der Bestimmungen des Abschnitts 15.7 vereinbaren die Parteien, dass jede einschlägige Verjährungs- oder Ausschlussfrist sowie jede Einreichungs- oder sonstige Frist ab dem Tag, an dem die schriftliche Beschreibung der Streitigkeit nach diesem Abschnitt 15.2 abgesendet wird, bis zum jeweils früheren der folgenden Zeitpunkte gehemmt ist: (a) dem Tag, an dem die Streitigkeit beigelegt, zurückgenommen oder im Wege eines Vergleichs erledigt wird; (b) dem Tag, an dem ein Schiedsverfahren oder ein Gerichtsverfahren betreffend die Streitigkeit eingeleitet wird; oder (c) sechzig (60) Tage nach Ablauf des vorstehend beschriebenen Zeitraums der informellen Beilegung, einschließlich einer von den Parteien vereinbarten Verlängerung.

Einwohner der Europäischen Union haben die Möglichkeit, ein Verfahren bei einer von der EU zertifizierten Stelle für außergerichtliche Streitbeilegung und Schlichtung einzuleiten, oder können Streitigkeiten jederzeit im Wege gerichtlicher Verfahren austragen. Die Gebühren für die außergerichtliche Streitbeilegung werden von der von der EU zertifizierten Stelle vor Aufnahme der außergerichtlichen Schlichtung festgesetzt. Scribd trägt alle Gebühren im Zusammenhang mit außergerichtlichen Streitigkeiten, die zugunsten eines EU-Einwohners entschieden werden.

Unbeschadet der Entscheidung der Parteien, alle Streitigkeiten im Schiedsverfahren beizulegen, behält sich jede Partei das Recht vor, (i) zu wählen, dass Ansprüche auf individueller Grundlage vor dem Gericht für geringfügige Forderungen entschieden werden, für Streitigkeiten und Klagen, die in den Zuständigkeitsbereich dieses Gerichts fallen, unabhängig davon, welches Forum die einreichende Partei zunächst gewählt hat; (ii) eine Klage vor einem einzelstaatlichen oder Bundesgericht zum Schutz ihrer Rechte des geistigen Eigentums zu erheben ("Rechte des geistigen Eigentums" bezeichnet in diesem Zusammenhang Patente, Urheberrechte, Urheberpersönlichkeitsrechte, Marken sowie Geschäftsgeheimnisse und sonstige vertrauliche oder geschützte Informationen, jedoch nicht Persönlichkeits- oder Bildnisrechte) oder wegen Verleumdung; und (iii) ein Feststellungsurteil, eine Unterlassungsverfügung oder eine sonstige Billigkeitsmaßnahme vor einem zuständigen Gericht in Bezug auf die Frage zu beantragen, ob die Ansprüche einer Partei verjährt sind. Unbeschadet der Bestimmungen dieses Abschnitts 15.3, die Fragen der Schiedsfähigkeit dem Schiedsrichter übertragen, wird die Frage, ob eine Streitigkeit in die Zuständigkeit des Gerichts für geringfügige Forderungen fällt, von diesem Gericht und nicht von einem Schiedsrichter entschieden. Bestreitet eine Partei, dass eine Streitigkeit in die Zuständigkeit des Gerichts für geringfügige Forderungen fällt, so wird jedes anhängige Schiedsverfahren betreffend diese Streitigkeit ausgesetzt, und die Parteien teilen NAM die Aussetzung unverzüglich mit. Die Aussetzung endet automatisch, wenn nicht innerhalb von dreißig (30) Tagen nach dem erstmaligen Bestreiten der Frage durch eine Partei eine Klage betreffend die Streitigkeit vor dem Gericht für geringfügige Forderungen erhoben wird, und bleibt im Übrigen in Kraft, bis das Gericht für geringfügige Forderungen die Verhandlung der Streitigkeit ablehnt oder feststellt, dass sie nicht in seine Zuständigkeit fällt. Die Beantragung solcher Maßnahmen stellt keinen Verzicht auf das Recht einer Partei auf Schiedsverfahren nach dieser Schiedsvereinbarung dar, und alle eingereichten Schiedsverfahren, die mit einer nach diesem Absatz erhobenen Klage in Zusammenhang stehen, werden bis zum Ausgang dieser Klage automatisch ausgesetzt.

Zur Steigerung der Effizienz der Verwaltung und Beilegung von Schiedsverfahren vereinbaren die Parteien, dass, falls einhundert (100) oder mehr gleichartige Schiedsanträge (solche, die dieselben oder im Wesentlichen gleichartige Sachverhalte oder Ansprüche geltend machen und dieselbe oder eine im Wesentlichen gleichartige Rechtsfolge begehren), die von oder mit Unterstützung oder Koordinierung derselben Anwaltskanzlei(en) oder Organisation(en) eingereicht werden, bei NAM gegen die Gesellschaft eingereicht werden (eine "Masseneinreichung" ("Mass Filing")), (i) die Masseneinreichung in Stapeln von 50 Anträgen je Stapel bearbeitet wird (soweit nach der vorstehend beschriebenen Stapelbildung weniger als 50 Schiedsanträge verbleiben, besteht ein letzter Stapel aus den verbleibenden Anträgen), wobei höchstens drei Stapel gleichzeitig eingereicht, bearbeitet und entschieden werden; (ii) für jeden Stapel ein Schiedsrichter bestellt wird, wobei NAM zusätzliche Schiedsrichter für Anträge innerhalb eines Stapels bestellen kann, wenn sie feststellt, dass dies eine effizientere Beilegung ermöglicht; (iii) die anwendbaren Gebühren akzeptiert werden, einschließlich einer von NAM nach ihrem Ermessen festgelegten damit verbundenen Gebührenreduzierung; (iv) nicht mehr als drei Stapel von Anträgen, die Teil der Masseneinreichung sind, gleichzeitig eingereicht, bearbeitet oder entschieden werden dürfen und ein weiterer Stapel eingereicht, bearbeitet und entschieden wird, sobald jeder anhängige Stapel entschieden oder auf andere Weise erledigt ist; (v) die mit einem Schiedsantrag im Rahmen einer Masseneinreichung verbundenen Gebühren, einschließlich der von der Gesellschaft und von den Antragstellern zu tragenden Gebühren, erst fällig werden, nachdem Ihr Schiedsantrag in eine Gruppe von Stapelverfahren aufgenommen und dieser Stapel ordnungsgemäß zur Einreichung, Bearbeitung und Entscheidung bestimmt worden ist; (vi) das gestufte Verfahren der Stapelverfahren, wobei jede Gruppe 50 Anträge umfasst, fortgesetzt wird, bis jeder Antrag (einschließlich Ihres Antrags) entschieden oder auf andere Weise erledigt ist; und (vii) nach Kräften und in gutem Glauben bemüht wird, jeden Stapel von Anträgen soweit möglich innerhalb von 180 Tagen beizulegen, andernfalls jeder der Antragsteller oder die Gesellschaft das Schiedsverfahren beenden und ein zuständiges Gericht anrufen kann. Anträgen in einer Masseneinreichung werden fortlaufende Nummern in der Reihenfolge ihrer Einreichung bei NAM zugewiesen; sie werden in dieser Reihenfolge Stapeln zugeordnet, und die Stapel werden in dieser Reihenfolge zur Einreichung, Bearbeitung und Entscheidung bestimmt.

Die Auswahl der Schiedsrichter für die Anträge jedes Stapels erfolgt soweit möglich nach den einschlägigen Regeln und Verfahren von NAM für diese Auswahl, und der Schiedsrichter bestimmt den Ort, an dem die Verfahren für jeden Antrag innerhalb eines Stapels durchgeführt werden.

Ist Ihr Schiedsantrag in die Masseneinreichung aufgenommen, so sind alle einschlägigen Verjährungs- und Ausschlussfristen sowie alle Einreichungs- oder sonstigen Fristen hinsichtlich Ihrer Ansprüche durchgehend gehemmt ab dem Tag, an dem die schriftliche Beschreibung der Streitigkeit nach Abschnitt 15.2 abgesendet wurde, oder, falls keine solche schriftliche Beschreibung abgesendet wurde, ab dem Tag, an dem Ihr Schiedsantrag bei NAM eingereicht wurde, bis Ihr Schiedsantrag entschieden, zurückgenommen oder im Wege eines Vergleichs erledigt ist, oder bis sechzig (60) Tage nach Beendigung des Schiedsverfahrens hinsichtlich Ihres Antrags, wie nach diesem Abschnitt 15.7 zulässig.

Die Parteien vereinbaren, dass diese Stapelbestimmung ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der Schiedsvereinbarung ist, soweit sie auf eine Masseneinreichung Anwendung findet. Wird die Stapelbestimmung dieses Unterabschnitts (15.7) im Hinblick auf Verfahren zwischen Ihnen und der Gesellschaft als unwirksam, nicht durchsetzbar oder rechtswidrig befunden, so ist diese Schiedsvereinbarung insgesamt zwischen Ihnen und der Gesellschaft nichtig und wirkungslos, und weder Sie noch die Gesellschaft sind berechtigt, einen Anspruch, der Teil der Masseneinreichung ist, einem Schiedsverfahren zu unterwerfen.

[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/change_language/de?return_to=/hc/de/articles/210129326-Globale-Nutzungsbedingungen)

### 15.8 Mediation nach der ersten Charge in einer Mass Filing[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/change_language/de?return_to=/hc/de/articles/210129326-Globale-Nutzungsbedingungen#h_01HRD8X55RS2XAGB3YS3B9ZP06)

Jederzeit ab dem Datum der Erledigung des Ersten Stapels können die Gesellschaft und die Rechtsbeistände der verbleibenden Antragsteller im gegenseitigen Einvernehmen einen Mediator von NAM hinzuziehen, um zu versuchen, die verbleibenden Anträge der Masseneinreichung beizulegen. Der NAM-Mediator kann aus einer Gruppe von fünf (5) von NAM zunächst vorgeschlagenen Mediatoren ausgewählt werden, wobei die Gesellschaft und die Rechtsbeistände der verbleibenden Antragsteller jeweils einen Mediator streichen und sodann die verbleibenden Mediatoren in eine Rangfolge bringen können, wobei der gemeinsam am höchsten eingestufte Mediator ausgewählt wird. Der ausgewählte Mediator wird versuchen, eine Beilegung der verbleibenden Anträge der Masseneinreichung zu erleichtern. Die Mediation nach diesem Unterabschnitt (15.8) ist freiwillig, und weder die Gesellschaft noch ein Antragsteller ist zur Teilnahme verpflichtet. Die Anhängigkeit einer Mediation nach diesem Unterabschnitt hemmt oder verzögert das in Unterabschnitt (15.7) beschriebene Stapelverfahren nicht, sofern die Parteien nichts anderes vereinbaren.

[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/change_language/de?return_to=/hc/de/articles/210129326-Globale-Nutzungsbedingungen)

### 15.9 Entscheidung des Schiedsrichters[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/change_language/de?return_to=/hc/de/articles/210129326-Globale-Nutzungsbedingungen#h_01HRD8X55R2HNHD15Y6VB4QPYB)

Der Schiedsrichter wird eine schriftliche, begründete Entscheidung gemäß den geltenden NAM-Regeln und -Verfahren erlassen. Das Urteil über den Schiedsrichterentscheid kann in jedem Gericht, das dafür zuständig ist, erlassen werden. Der Schiedsrichter hat die Befugnis, monetäre Schäden auf individueller Basis zuzusprechen und auf individueller Basis jede nicht-monetäre Abhilfe oder Erleichterung zu gewähren, die einer Einzelperson im Rahmen des geltenden Rechts, der Regeln des Schiedsgerichts und dieses Schiedsvertrags zur Verfügung steht. Die Parteien stimmen zu, dass die Schäden und/oder andere Erleichterungen mit den Bedingungen des Abschnitts „Haftungsbeschränkung und Schäden“ dieser Bedingungen hinsichtlich der Arten und Beträge von Schäden oder anderen Erleichterungen, für die eine Partei haftbar gemacht werden kann, übereinstimmen müssen. Kein individueller Schiedsrichterentscheid oder -beschluss hat eine präkludierende Wirkung auf Fragen oder Ansprüche in einem Streitfall mit jemandem, der nicht eine benannte Partei im Schiedsverfahren ist. Anwaltsgebühren stehen der obsiegenden Partei im Schiedsverfahren zur Verfügung, wenn dies nach dem geltenden materiellen Recht, das die Ansprüche im Schiedsverfahren regelt, zulässig ist.

[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/change_language/de?return_to=/hc/de/articles/210129326-Globale-Nutzungsbedingungen)

### 15.10 Gebühren[](https://support.scribd.com/hc/change_language/de?return_to=/hc/de/articles/210129326-Globale-Nutzungsbedingungen#h_01HRD8X55REXKAJKEWEPM5ED3Z)

Können Sie darlegen, dass die Kosten des Schiedsverfahrens im Vergleich zu den Kosten eines Gerichtsverfahrens prohibitiv sind, so erstattet die Gesellschaft alle Einreichungs- und Verhandlungsgebühren über $250 hinaus, die der Schiedsrichter für erforderlich hält, um zu verhindern, dass das Schiedsverfahren kostenmäßig prohibitiv ist, unabhängig vom Ausgang des Schiedsverfahrens, es sei denn, der Schiedsrichter stellt fest, dass Ihr Anspruch oder Ihre Ansprüche rechtsmissbräuchlich waren oder in bösem Glauben geltend gemacht wurden; in diesem Fall können Ihnen die Schiedsgebühren (einschließlich Rechtsanwaltsgebühren) im Einklang mit den Regeln des Schiedsrichters und dem in der Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 11 festgelegten Maßstab für Sanktionen auferlegt werden. Die Parteien vereinbaren, dass NAM nach ihrem Ermessen den Betrag oder den Zeitpunkt von Verwaltungs- oder Schiedsgebühren, die nach den Regeln von NAM geschuldet sind, herabsetzen oder ändern kann, wenn sie dies für angemessen hält (einschließlich der Regelung in Ziffer (v) des Unterabschnitts (15.7)), sofern eine solche Änderung Ihre Kosten nicht erhöht, und Sie vereinbaren ferner, auf jeden Einwand gegen eine solche Gebührenänderung zu verzichten. Die Parteien vereinbaren außerdem, dass eine in gutem Glauben erhobene Beanstandung der von NAM auferlegten Gebühren durch eine der Parteien keinen Verzug, Verzicht oder Verstoß gegen diese Schiedsvereinbarung darstellt, solange diese Beanstandung bei NAM, dem Schiedsrichter und/oder einem zuständigen Gericht anhängig ist, und dass alle Fälligkeitstermine für diese Gebühren während der Anhängigkeit dieser Beanstandung gehemmt sind.
